question.prompt: Is \(x=2\) a solution of the equation \(3x-1=5\)? (Answer “yes” or “no.”)

solutions.explanation: Substituting \(x=2\) gives \(3\times2-1=5\) on the left, which equals the right side, so \(x=2\) is a solution of the equation.
solutions.title: Check by substitution
